title: Virtual Card Management: How to Issue a Virtual Card in Seconds
summary: Explains how to issue a virtual card by going to Virtual Cards → Issue New Card, selecting the managing Team/user, adding a nickname and intended use, choosing Single-use for one-time payments (or multi-use otherwise), and clicking Issue. Provisioning takes ~5 seconds and the card is immediately visible/usable; includes post-issuance checks for owner/team assignment and Active status within 5 seconds.
